nodes.name: Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer: Adam → Enoch → Shem Intercalation & 7-Epoch Covenant
nodes.notes: Ch. 8–22 traces the sacred calendar secret handed from Adam through Enoch, Noah & Shem to Abraham & Moses.

nodes.name: Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer: Adam's Skin Garments Passed via Noah → Ham → Nimrod → Esau
nodes.notes: Famous Midrashic link connecting Nimrod's hunting coat back to Adam and forward to Esau (Gen 25:27–34).

nodes.name: Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer Ch. 30: Ishmael's Wives ('Aisha / Fatima / Meribah) & Abraham's Visits
nodes.notes: Preserves parallel Islamic-Jewish tradition on Ishmael's two wives and Abraham's desert visits.

nodes.name: Apocrypha Arabica (Kitab al-Magall / Book of the Rolls): Adam → Seth → Noah Cave Treasures
nodes.notes: 10th-century Sinai Arabic manuscript closely parallel to Syriac Cave of Treasures tracing every patriarch from Adam to Christ.

nodes.name: Kitab al-Magall: Shem & Melchizedek Guardians at Golgotha / Jerusalem
nodes.notes: Details Shem & Melchizedek carrying Adam's body to Jerusalem.

nodes.name: Kitab al-Magall: 64-Generation Royal-Priestly Pedigree of Virgin Mary to King David
nodes.notes: Constructs an explicit 64-generation stemma joining Judah, David, and Mary in Christian-Arabic tradition.
